description: This file is a Java JUnit test class for integration testing the 'DocumentsApiFixed' service in the 'fineract-client' project, specifically testing operations such as retrieving, downloading, and deleting document data through mocked HTTP responses.

classes.name: DocumentsApiFixedIntegrationTest
classes.description: JUnit 5 integration test class for testing 'DocumentsApiFixed' service operations such as retrieval, download, and deletion of documents using WireMock for mocked HTTP responses.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the WireMock server, configures the client, and creates a test document file before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Stops the WireMock server after each test.

methods.name: testGetDocumentsForClient
methods.description: Tests retrieval of documents for a client, mocking a JSON response with a list of documents.

methods.name: testGetDocumentsForLoan
methods.description: Tests retrieval of documents for a loan, mocking a JSON response with a document list.

methods.name: testGetDocumentsEmpty
methods.description: Tests retrieval returning an empty list, simulating no documents for a specific client ID.

methods.name: testGetSingleDocument
methods.description: Tests fetching a single document's details by ID.

methods.name: testDownloadDocument
methods.description: Tests downloading a document, mocking a PDF content response.

methods.name: testDeleteDocument
methods.description: Tests deletion of a document, verifying the response contains expected resource ID.

methods.name: testDeleteDocumentForLoan
methods.description: Tests deletion of a document associated with a loan.

methods.name: testMultipleEntityTypes
methods.description: Tests retrieval of document lists across multiple entity types with different IDs.

methods.name: testDownloadTextDocument
methods.description: Tests downloading a plain text document, verifying content and headers.
